decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is close to the firm's core formulation know-how and supplier base, and it has its own page, so the firm can read its results and refine it in-house, which justifies keeping it.
A cleansing milk is a staple that fits the existing facial range and uses established in-house knowledge at low small-batch cost, so the firm keeps it while it keeps learning from customer feedback.

The cleansing oil was only launched in 2024 and builds directly on the firm's natural oil and cleansing know-how, so management should let it gather more market evidence before judging it, even though it is only mentioned briefly on the website.
